items.mainDefect: After taking the write lock, the code does not check the cache again, so concurrent first requests each rebuild the manifest one after another.

secondary.defect: The cache is assigned even when the read fails, so a transient error stores nil or bad data in the cache and replaces a valid value.

items.mainDefect: After taking the write lock, the code does not check the cache again, so concurrent first callers each rebuild the entry point assets.

secondary.defect: entryPointAssetsCache = result runs even when err != nil, so a failed or partial load is cached and served to every later reader in non-dev mode.
